classification_statement: Full-orbit collisionless test-particle electron wall-loss probabilities (orbit_mc v1.7) integrated in the accepted L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current field maps of the geometry sweep v2, launched in the separatrix-bounded wall cells of the accepted cusp topology search v3.1 catalogue. The fields are L1a screening fields (not P2-qualified), so every sweep-design number in this campaign is SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS: never accepted physical-orbit evidence, never a plasma or performance claim. One additional row (the v4 divergent-exit design) is integrated on its NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED field with THIS campaign's screening launch design and is labelled P2_QUALIFIED_FIELD_SCREENING_LAUNCH_DESIGN; it is not a replication of v4's accepted evidence. Every per-cell number is a collisionless geometric wall-access fraction of the launch distribution, never a cusp-loss probability.

claim_boundary.field_level: L1a linear constant-permeability axisymmetric equivalent-current FDM (cft_revival.fields); non-authoritative current bands, not a permanent-magnet material model, not P2 FEM, not hardware-valid (sweep rows); P2 adaptive FEM level-1 map through the v4 adapter (P2 row only)
claim_boundary.orbit_model: collisionless prescribed-field relativistic-Boris test particles; no electric field, no collisions, no sheath, no self-consistent plasma
claim_boundary.estimand: per catalogue cell: the fraction of electrons launched at the cell's launch plane (two radius bands, 5/25 eV, 20/70 deg, both directions, scrambled-Sobol gyrophase) that first reach the straight dielectric wall; a collisionless geometric wall-access fraction, NOT a Kornfeld per-cusp-transit loss probability and NOT a cusp probability for the plasma network without a declared closure
claim_boundary.two_stage_estimator: the per-cell estimate pools stage-1 and stage-2 launches with equal weights; because the stage-2 sample size depends on the stage-1 counts, the pooled estimate carries an adaptive-allocation bias of order 1/n that is negligible against the floor; stage-1, stage-2 and pooled counts are all recorded so a consumer can use the stage-2-only estimate
claim_boundary.design_pooled_values: design averages of the per-cell estimates with declared weights (cell wall areas; launch counts as the v1-comparable alternative); they are summaries of the per-cell structure, not estimands in their own right
usable_as: surrogate training labels per catalogue cell (surrogate v3) labelled SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS with the per-cell floor
design- and cell-dependent geometric access fractions for the MDO closures CL-3-sheath-limited / CL-4-hybrid-area under their labels
a formal consumer of the orbit_mc coupling-v4.2 export format and of the v3.1 cusp-cell catalogue

authority.base_commit_note: origin/feat/sota-foundation head at worktree creation (9abbd537, cusp topology search v3 dashboard); the preregistration commit itself is recorded by execute in the lock
authority.template_reuse: field re-solve pipeline with identity proofs (designs.py: load_sweep_binding, rebuild_case, resolve_design, field_identity, field_pipeline_source_sha256), the coupling consumer (consumer.py: verify_handoff, consume_handoff, consume_v4_export), the v4 mechanics (ValidatorLedger, run_case_integration, run_case_export, run_stage, stratum_summaries, result_diagnostics, mu_diagnostic, orbit_mc source/contract binding) are imported from v1/v4 with attribution. New in v2: catalogue cells as launch cells (cells.py), scrambled-Sobol launch sets (sobol.py), the frozen two-stage allocation rule, the 2N control subset, per-cell estimators with floors, the P2 row.
authority.literature_basis: modern/docs/LITERATURE_SYNTHESIS.md section 5.2 (step 2) and modern/docs/literature/surrogate-mdo-validation-blockers.md blocker 1 (rows S1a, S1c, S1d, S1e adopted; option B - 40 designs x 2048 - rejected)

orbit_mc_contract.source_hash_line_endings: LF (repo-wide .gitattributes eol=lf since fab0eccc); the hash is over the working-tree bytes and fails closed on any CR byte
orbit_mc_contract.backend: numpy-cpu-relativistic-boris only; the Warp CUDA path is not used (RTX 5090 occupied by a PIC run; per-particle CUDA is 18x slower than numpy for this event loop)

known_defect_v1_7.statement: orbit_mc v1.7 validate_result_artifact (_validate_probability) and coupling_v42_handoff require lower <= probability <= upper verbatim, but wilson_interval(0, n).lower is a positive round-off (~1e-17) for 734 of the first 4000 n (3, 6, 7, 12, 14, 24, ..., 384, 768, 1536, ...) and wilson_interval(n, n).upper is 1 - ulp for 1238 of them (512, 640, 1152, 1920, ...). A case whose zero-count category (timeouts are always zero) or full-count category lands on such an n cannot be sealed. The package is frozen; this campaign therefore fixes every case size to a value that is exact at both ends (128 launches per cell block, 16 / 64 per control case) and refuses any plan whose case sizes are not (require_safe_case_sizes; tests pin the safe set).
known_defect_v1_7.discovered: v2 shakedown 3 (2026-09-03): a 6-launch control case with zero timeouts failed 'summary incomplete confidence interval is not the exact Wilson result'
known_defect_v1_7.v1_note: v1's 512-launch cases were k=0-exact by luck (512 is only k=n-inexact, and no v1 case had a full-count category)

field_source.map_availability: Only the four representative designs (roles strongest-centreline, strongest-mirror, steepest-stage-gradient, lowest-field-energy/best-boundary-isolation) carry stored full-field maps in results/representatives; the other 92 designs are recorded as QoIs only. Every design is therefore re-solved.

resolve.identity_proof: rebuilt geometry_sha256, source_sha256, config_sha256 and case_sha256 must equal the sealed raw-results record; the re-solved QoIs must reproduce the recorded QoIs within the sweep's preregistered scale-aware replay tolerances; representatives must additionally reproduce the stored full-field nodes
resolve.source_binding: field_pipeline_source_sha256 over cft_revival/{fields,geometry,magnetics,optimization}/**/*.py, spec/fields/*.json and l1a_geometry_sweep_v2/{experiment.py,protocol.py,protocol.json,protocol.json.sha256} (LF bytes) is recorded in shakedown.json and authorities.json and re-verified by execute

refined_diagnostic.coverage: EVERY sweep-v2 design (96/96): the same problem re-solved at 160x288 intervals; compare_maps(accepted bore field, refined bore field) must stay within maximum_cross_resolution_b_relative_rms for every design. No refined-field orbit case is run (v1 ran refined-N orbits for its four representatives; v1's README overstated its cross-resolution coverage, which was the four representatives only).
refined_diagnostic.purpose: field-resolution diagnostic and binding field-adapter gate for every design

field_source.bore_grid_rule: radial nodes 0..first node >= wall radius; axial nodes from the last node <= domain_z_min_m to the first node >= chamber length; every cell is homogeneous plasma (material id l1a-vacuum-bore-screening); PsiBicubicField built from psi with the solver's Br/Bz as reference maps (5 % consistency check) and the certificate tightness floor from gates

cusp_cell_catalogue.loader: experiments.cusp_topology_search_v3_1.catalogue.load_catalogue (refuses the v3 bundle and any edited copy; verifies the bytes against the sealed manifest)
cusp_cell_catalogue.cell_definition: wall cusp := intersection of the separatrix of an axis null with the straight dielectric wall (root of psi(r_w, z) - psi_axis); cell := wall interval between consecutive wall cusps, plus the anode-side partial cell [straight_z_min, z_c1] and the exit-side partial cell [z_cK, straight_z_max]; sweep-v2 designs carry N-1 wall cusps for N stages (2/3/4 cusps for 30/47/19 designs; 373 cells: 96 anode partials, 181 interior, 96 exit partials)
cusp_cell_catalogue.label_statement: the catalogue's mirror descriptors (wall/axis mirror ratios) are field ratios, never probabilities; they are carried into the dataset as cell geometry only
cusp_cell_catalogue.binding: load_bound_catalogue verifies catalogue_file_sha256, manifest_file_sha256, schema, experiment_id, protocol_semantic_sha256 and the design counts before any cell is used; the per-design cells written to design-authorities.json must equal the catalogue cells at execute (catalogue_binding gate)

designs.source_set: the 96 accepted sweep-v2 designs (every design of the sweep) + the P2 divergent-exit design
designs.representative_role: full orbit artifacts are published for the representatives and the P2 row; every other sealed artifact is identified by its sidecar hash and its endpoint table (v1 policy)

p2_design.label: P2_QUALIFIED_FIELD_SCREENING_LAUNCH_DESIGN
p2_design.field_level: NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED (v4 accepted field, level-1 FEM checkpoint through the hash-bound v4 adapter); launch design = this campaign's screening design
p2_design.wall_domain_authority: v4 protocol orbit.wall (r 2 mm, z 1..18 mm straight dielectric) and orbit.domain (z 1..23 mm regular plasma domain of the field data); max_path/max_time from this campaign's orbit_geometry_rule with L = chamber length 24 mm (v4 used 30 mm / 10 ns), so the P2 row is a screening launch design on the qualified field, not a v4 replication
p2_design.statement: included as the 97th dataset row iff its v3.1 catalogue entry exists and is stable; reported under its own label and never pooled with the sweep rows

designs.fallback_rule: a design whose field cannot be rebuilt, re-solved or verified against its sealed record (or whose catalogue entry is missing/unstable) is EXCLUDED before any orbit is integrated and listed with its reason in artifacts/design-exclusions.json; the campaign proceeds on the remaining designs (deterministic subset)

orbit_geometry_rule.wall_z_min_meaning: anode plane (dielectric-straight region spans 0 <= z <= exit_start)
orbit_geometry_rule.wall_z_max: chamber.exit_start_m (end of the straight dielectric; equals chamber.length_m when the design has no divergent exit)
orbit_geometry_rule.divergent_exit_policy: wall-hit authority is restricted to the straight cylindrical dielectric section exactly as v4 did; an electron reaching r = wall radius at z > exit_start enters the divergent section and is classified domain_escape (post hoc sub-class divergent_section_radial); z = 0 is upstream_anode_plane escape; z = chamber length is exit_plane escape
orbit_geometry_rule.max_time_rule: max_time_s = max_time_transit_factor * max_path_m / v(slowest_energy_ev); i.e. twice the time a 5 eV electron needs for two channel lengths

launches.stratification_statement: the eight (energy, pitch, direction) strata of every cell receive exactly the same number of launches (16 at stage 1, 64 after a top-up); the continuous coordinates are scrambled-Sobol inside each stratum, so the launch set is phase-space stratified

sobol.generator: experiments.orbit_wall_loss_geometry_screening_v2.sobol.scrambled_sobol (Joe-Kuo direction numbers, Gray-code order, 32 digits; Matousek linear matrix scrambling + digital shift from numpy default_rng)
sobol.seed_rule: seed = first 8 bytes of sha256('<seed_namespace>:<design_key>:<cell_id>:<stratum_id>'); one independent scrambled sequence per (design, cell, stratum); designs never share a launch set (Chen et al. 2012, S1e)
sobol.stage2_extends_stage1: stage 2 uses indices 16..63 of the same sequence whose indices 0..15 formed stage 1, so the 64-point union is a (t,6,3)-net per stratum

launches.radius_rule: two launch radius bands [0.650, 0.700] and [0.775, 0.825] of the design's wall radius, centred on v4/v1's 0.675 and 0.800; the band is chosen by the first Sobol coordinate (exactly half the points of every stratum per band for 2^m points), the radius inside the band by the second, the gyrophase by the third (2 pi u)
launches.launch_plane_statement: every cell launches at its midpoint: between its two wall cusps for interior cells, between the channel end and the cusp for the anode-side / exit-side partial cells; launches sit at y = 0 (axisymmetry). A midpoint inside the injector zone [straight_z_min, injector_length] is flagged (launch_plane_inside_injector_zone), never moved: the catalogue has one such cell (l1a-gs-v2-088, 0.16 mm anode-side cell). Cells shorter than short_cell_length_m are flagged (short_cell): 13 sweep cells (12 exit-side, 1 anode-side) and the P2 exit-side cell (28 um)
launches.launch_id_rule: <campaign_id>:E<energy index>:P<pitch index>:X<catalogue cell index>:D<+1|-1>:G<scrambled-Sobol point index> (orbit_mc v1.7's launch-id grammar; X is the cell, G the Sobol index whose point fixes the radius band, the radius and the gyrophase); seed_id = first 8 bytes of sha256(launch_id) (orbit_mc build_launch_ensemble rule); the campaign-free launch key E..:P..:X..:D..:G.. identifies the same physical launch across the N cases and the 2N control
launches.candidate_superset: the complete set of 64 indices per stratum (512 launches per cell) is hashed per design at prepare (candidate_launches_sha256); every stage-2 launch must be a member

allocation.statement: two-stage frozen allocation: stage 1 integrates 128 scrambled-Sobol launches per catalogue cell for every design (one case per cell); stage 2 tops a cell up to 512 launches (three further 128-launch blocks, indices 16..63 of every stratum) iff the cell's stage-1 Wilson 95 % interval width for P(wall) exceeds 0.10; cells at or below the threshold are saturated and receive nothing; the rule is evaluated by code inside the single execution (per-design worker) and replayed by the main process from the endpoint terminations; no allocation decision is taken by a human after the counts are seen
allocation.saturation_meaning: Wilson width <= 0.10 at n = 128 holds iff p_hat is outside about (0.094, 0.906); the top-up therefore goes to the mixed cells whose labels are binomial-noise limited
allocation.rejected_alternative: option B of the synthesis (40 designs x 2048 launches) was REJECTED; every design is kept
allocation.planning_assumption_basis: v1: 276 of 384 fixed-fraction cells had Wilson width > 0.10 at n = 128 (recorded bundle); the true fraction for catalogue cells is an outcome of this campaign

control.statement: N -> 2N convergence control (MLMC logic): a frozen-seed random subset of one eighth of every cell's FINAL launches (16 of 128, 64 of 512; ceil(10 %) rounded up to the next power of two so that the control case sizes are Wilson-exact, see orbit_mc_contract.known_defect_v1_7) is re-integrated at the 2N time step; the paired difference of the wall-hit fraction over the same launches estimates the N-vs-2N bias of the reported N values
control.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(first 8 bytes of sha256('<seed_namespace>:<design_key>:<cell_id>:control')).choice(n_cell, n_cell / 8, replace=False) over the cell's lexicographically sorted final launch keys
control.binding_gate: |P_wall,2N(control) - P_wall,N(control)| <= 0.02 POOLED over all control launches of all designs (paired over identical launches)
control.per_design_flag: timestep_passed := |Delta P| <= 0.02 on the design's own control subset (all its cells pooled, 48..320 launches); it is the orbit_mc convergence-evidence flag that decides sealing (as v1's N/2N check did) and is reported, never campaign-binding; the design's control quantum 1/n_control is recorded because one discordant orbit in a 48-launch control (0.0208) exceeds 0.02
reported: per design: n_control, discordant orbit count, P_N(control), P_2N(control), Delta P, quantum
campaign: pooled Delta P, pooled discordance rate, estimated N-vs-2N bias with its standard error
control.prior_expectation: v1 recorded 22 discordant orbits in 49,152 N/2N pairs (0.045 %)
control.fraction_rule: 1/8 of the cell's final launches (>= the 10 % of the synthesis); exact integers 16 and 64

cases.unit: one orbit_mc case = one (design, catalogue cell, block of 16 scrambled-Sobol indices per stratum) at one time step = 128 launches (stage 1 and every stage-2 block) or a 16 / 64-launch control case

stages.stage1: block 0 (indices 0..15 per stratum) of every cell, time step N; launch authority frozen at preregistration (one case authority per cell)
stages.stage2b1, stage2b2, stage2b3: blocks 1..3 (indices 16..63 per stratum) of the cells the frozen rule tops up, time step N; launch sets determined inside the worker from the cell's stage-1 counts (absent for saturated cells)
stages.control: the frozen-seed control subset of the cell's final launches (16 of 128 or 64 of 512), time step 2N

cases.case_size_rule: every case size must be Wilson-exact at k = 0 and k = n (orbit_mc_contract.known_defect_v1_7); evidentiary_plan/shakedown_plan refuse otherwise
cases.reported_probability_case: N (all N-step blocks of a cell pooled with equal weights); the 2N control estimates the N -> 2N bias
cases.sealing: every case of a design is sealed (write_artifact deterministic replay + verified reload + coupling-v4.2 handoff) iff the design's three orbit_mc convergence-evidence flags are true (timestep_passed = the design's paired control flag, cross_map_passed = field adapter incl. cross-resolution, backend_parity_passed = CPU parity); an unsealed design is reported through its summaries and endpoint tables and carries no handoff

estimators.per_cell: counts pooled over stage 1 and stage 2 (equal weights); Wilson 95 % intervals for P(wall), P(reflect), P(escape), P(timeout); stage-1, stage-2 and stage-2-only values recorded
estimators.binomial_floor: sqrt(p_hat (1 - p_hat) / n) at the pooled estimate (zero at p_hat in {0, 1}) and the Jeffreys-mean floor sqrt(p~ (1 - p~) / n) with p~ = (k + 1/2)/(n + 1)
estimators.surrogate_readiness_rule: a cell is surrogate-v3 ready iff its Jeffreys floor <= 0.02; the fraction of ready cells is reported (a cell with p_hat ~ 0.5 at n = 512 has floor 0.022 and is NOT ready by this rule)
estimators.design_pooled: design average of the per-cell P(wall) with weights = catalogue cell wall areas 2 pi r_w (z_end - z_start) (declared value) and with weights = final launch counts (v1-comparable alternative); 95 % normal-approximation intervals from the per-cell binomial variances
estimators.v1_comparison: the same 96 fields carried different cells (v1: four fixed fractions of the straight span, 128 launches each at exactly 0.675/0.800 r_w with an 8-gyrophase grid); a direct per-cell comparison is therefore NOT possible; the comparison is between v1's pooled 2N value (512 launches) and v2's launch-weighted and area-weighted pooled values, per design and as rank correlation

shakedown.purpose: Exercise the complete production path (catalogue binding, sweep binding, CPU re-solve incl. refined, P2 adapter, scrambled-Sobol launches, stage-1 integration, the allocation rule with both branches, stage-2 top-up block, control subset at 2N, checkpoint chains, validators, sealing, handoff consumer, estimators, dataset/CSV assembly, publication through the shared ExperimentRuntime into a temporary root, validate_bundle) on REAL fields for three sweep designs and the P2 design before the preregistration freeze
shakedown.design_rule: first, median and last of the sorted sweep ids (the first is a representative) plus the P2 row so the v4 adapter path is exercised
shakedown.threshold_rule: 0.25 so that at n = 16 a saturated cell (0/16 or 16/16, width 0.19) is NOT topped up while any mixed cell is; both branches of the rule are exercised; stage 2 is one 16-launch block (stage2_points 4 = 2 blocks of 2)
prepare_requires: passed == true (all validators passed for every shakedown case; export and consumer stages ran; bundle validated; both allocation branches observed)
protocol_semantic_sha256 equals the current protocol hash
orbit_mc_source_sha256, field_pipeline_source_sha256 and experiment_code_sha256 equal the current hashes
disjointness proven against the evidentiary design of the same designs
timing projection within budget under the planning assumption

gates.scope: evaluated PER DESIGN; the numerical/structural gates are binding for the dataset as a whole (a failure of any design rejects the execution); the control flag is per design (sealing) and its pooled form is campaign-binding
gates.control_gate_rule: pooled |P_2N - P_N| over all control launches <= 0.02
gates.allocation_rule_replay: the main process recomputes the top-up set from the stage-1 endpoint terminations and the control subset from the final launch keys; both must equal the worker's realised stage-2 and control launch sets (byte hash of the runtime launch payloads and content hash of the launch records)
gates.catalogue_binding: the cells of every design in design-authorities.json equal the cells derived from the hash-bound catalogue at execute
gates.timeout_policy: time_timeout and path_timeout are physical budget outcomes (survived two channel lengths of path); reported as the 'timeout' estimand per cell and per design and flagged, not gated
gates.backend_parity_scope: cpu parity only (numpy vs Warp CPU); CUDA parity is not evaluated because the GPU is occupied and no CUDA path is used by this campaign
gates.energy_gate_note: BINDING. Under orbit_mc >= 1.6 the event velocity is the Boris state at the event time, so in a prescribed pure-B field the relative kinetic-energy drift of every orbit is exactly 0.0.

magnetic_moment_variation.statement: mu variation is reported per design (min/median/max, counts above 0.1 and 0.5) and never compared against a threshold that accepts or rejects anything; electrons in these cusp fields are non-adiabatic by construction.

diagnostics.tolerance_close_share: fraction of orbits terminated through the typed tolerance-close fraction-zero path (physical wall/domain contact within event_tolerance_m); reported per design
diagnostics.reflection_counts: reported per design, per cell and per stratum (v1: 22 % of orbits reflected in every design; v4: zero)
diagnostics.per_cell_by_position: per-cell P(wall) distributions reported by position class (anode_side / interior / exit_side) and by cell count of the design

execution.cpu_budget_note: at most 12 of the 24 logical CPUs (the GPU runs a PIC campaign and is not touched)
execution.parallel_determinism_rule: every label access (stage-1 case, adaptive stage-2 block cases, adaptive control case of every cell) is recorded before any orbit is integrated; field solves and designs then run in spawn process pools; every design is one worker task (per cell: stage 1 -> rule -> stage-2 blocks -> control; then flags -> sealing) so designs are independent; each orbit is a pure function of (launch, field, config); every case is re-integrated twice by the deterministic replay validators (write + verified reload) and the first two launches of every case are re-integrated in the main process
execution.budget_rule: prepare requires the shakedown's projected wall time under the planning assumption (72 % of cells topped up, 3 integrations per orbit, contention factor 1.35, 12 workers) to be <= budget_wall_seconds; the worst case (every cell topped up) is recorded

per_case: artifacts/summaries/<case_key>.json (summary, 8 strata with Wilson intervals, preflight, checkpoint-chain hashes, diagnostics, timing, case authority)
artifacts/endpoints/<case_key>.json.gz (one compact row per orbit incl. the campaign-free launch key, cell, band, Sobol index, stage)
artifacts/orbits/<case_key>.json.sha256 (sealed orbit artifact sidecar; full artifacts for the representatives and the P2 row)
per_design: artifacts/field-evidence/<design_key>.json (identity proof, QoI replay, stored-map agreement, interpolation and cross-resolution reports)

coupling_consumer.v4_absence_statement: The v4 design (divergent-exit-stack, P2 FEM, NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED) is not a sweep-v2 design; its accepted coupling-v4.2 export is consumed as the accepted-evidence reference row, labelled as such. The P2 row of THIS dataset integrates the same field with the screening launch design and is labelled P2_QUALIFIED_FIELD_SCREENING_LAUNCH_DESIGN; it is a different launch distribution and is never compared to v4 as a replication. Every sealed case handoff (stage1-N, stage2-N, control-2N) is consumed through the same verified path; the dataset's per-cell values are pooled from the sealed cases' strata and are cross-checked against them.
consumer_checks: closed key set and constants of the handoff schema
successes = round(probability * trial_count) reproduces probability exactly
orbit_result_artifact_sha256 equals the sealed orbit artifact sidecar hash

v1_comparison.v1_value: reported accepted-2N pooled P(wall) over 512 launches (four fixed-fraction cells x 128)
v1_comparison.statement: same 96 fields, different cells and different launch distributions; a direct per-cell comparison is not possible; the pooled values are compared per design (difference, interval overlap) and as Spearman rank correlation, and the comparison is reported, never gated

v1_screening.headline: 96 designs, 100,352 orbits, pooled P(wall) 0.35-0.73 (2N), reflections in every design (22 % of orbits), 96/96 converged N->2N (max change 0.0059), 108/384 cells saturated at n = 128

v4.headline: one P2-qualified design; wall-hit 0.641-0.645, escape 0.355-0.359, zero reflections, zero timeouts; cells 2-3 100 % wall loss, cell 4 (past wall end) 100 % escape, cell 1 direction-dependent

prior_campaign_disclosure.v1_v2_v3: failed on code (see v4 protocol prior_campaign_disclosure); gyrophase offsets 0, 0, pi/16
prior_campaign_disclosure.relation: This campaign is the successor of the v1 screening dataset with catalogue cells, scrambled-Sobol launch sets and the two-stage allocation; it is NOT a successor of v4's evidence class. Its launch sets are disjoint from v1-v4 by launch id, seed and (with probability one) position/gyrophase: v1-v4 launched at exactly 0.675/0.800 r_w with 8-point gyrophase grids, v2 draws radii inside bands and gyrophases from scrambled Sobol.
